label: PF Backlog 501
title: AI (LLM) review of backlog context: is an item implementable (what/why/how/where)?
body:
## Problem / why
A heuristic gate can check that fields are present but cannot judge whether the context MEANS enough to implement the item. Placeholder-but-non-empty context still passes heuristics.

## Goal & value
An LLM judge reviews an item's context and reports whether it is implementable (what/why/how/where) with the missing dimensions — advisory by default, fail-closed on --strict.

delivery.note: LLM context review via the single LLM owner (core/context_review) + API endpoint + tooling; advisory. merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: Heuristic checks can't judge whether context is meaningful/implementable.
brief.what_adds: An LLM context review (what/why/how/where) via the single LLM owner, API-first + tooling; advisory default, --strict fail-closed.
brief.why: Ensure every backlog item is genuinely implementable, not just non-empty.
brief.who_feels: Backlog readers; agents/workers claiming work; maintainers.

objective: Add an LLM-judged backlog context review (implementable? what/why/how/where?) reusing the single LLM owner, exposed via API + a tooling check (advisory default; --strict fail-closed).
acceptance_criteria: core/context_review.review(item) returns {ok, source, implementable, missing, reason} via the single LLM owner
no validator available => ok=None (advisory, never a false verdict)
scripts/dev/backlog_context_ai_check.py batch-reviews open items (advisory; --strict fails on thin items)
approach: Reuse the single LLM owner (ModelRouter + LLMClient) via a one-shot callable; follow the brief_check injection pattern; render the item and ask for a compact JSON verdict; advisory when no validator.

divergences: new module + endpoint + tooling (new path, approved)

risks: LLM cost/latency on batch; mitigated by advisory + on-demand tooling

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/context_discipline.py, core/context_engine.py

_note: Delivered + validated (5 tests passed, api-governance 148 paths in sync, store-check OK, wired-audit unwired 0, lint 0 NEW)
